description:
Experience you will need:

5 to 6 years of experience with Net Framework 4.0 (4.5 is a plus)
Knowledge of MVC, JQuery, C# / SQL Server are musts (MVC 6 is a plus)
Experience designing enterprise level web solutions
SQL knowledge: Tables, Views, Stored Procedures
Understanding of web development best practices and software development tools
Willing to be hands-on in development
Must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Provide timely updates on tasks and meet internal and client deadlines with high-quality deliverables

Nice to have:

ASP.NET 5 is highly preferred
Knowledge of Entity Framework is a plus. 


Net Framework 4.0,MVC, JQuery, C#
 Only GC/Citizen
